subject.title: [Feature]: Ali bailian coding plan support ( thinking/reasoning enabled )

question: Should OpenClaw officially enable reasoning for Bailian/Qwen Coding Plan in the bundled qwen provider, and for which endpoints and models versus custom-provider opt-in?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent behavior depends on maintainer acceptance of vendor-specific endpoint/model support, provider catalog visibility, and upgrade behavior for existing qwen/modelstudio configs.

options.title: Approve verified qwen-owned support
options.body: Enable only live-verified Coding Plan models/endpoints, keep unsupported ones suppressed, and update docs/tests plus custom-provider inference as needed.

options.title: Keep explicit opt-in only
options.body: Preserve the conservative bundled catalog and document that subscribers must use explicit configured model rows where their plan supports reasoning.

options.title: Defer to Token Plan
options.body: Treat the separate Token Plan provider path as the supported Alibaba prepaid reasoning route and leave Coding Plan reasoning unsupported for now.

recommendation.title: Approve verified qwen-owned support
recommendation.body: Enable only live-verified Coding Plan models/endpoints, keep unsupported ones suppressed, and update docs/tests plus custom-provider inference as needed.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the qwen provider surface and is the strongest available owner signal for deciding the bundled provider boundary.
